seoTitle: Import AliExpress Reviews to Shopify With AI, Free
metaDescription: Install Kudosi (Ali Reviews) on Shopify, import AliExpress product reviews in bulk, and add the Review Box to your theme for free.
intro: Manually copying reviews product by product is slow, which is why an app built specifically for AliExpress review import is worth using over doing it by hand. This guide follows the actual setup for Kudosi, formerly known as Ali Reviews — installing it, granting it the access it needs, and getting through its built-in setup wizard to the point where reviews actually display on your storefront. The process is free to start, which matters for dropshippers and small stores who don't want another line item in their app budget.

steps.heading: Install the review app and check its permissions
steps.body: Search the Shopify App Store for Kudosi (Ali Reviews), built by FireApps, and click Install. Before confirming, Shopify shows exactly what the app can access: personal data covering customers, store owner, and content providers, and store data covering customers, products, orders, discounts, and your Online Store. This is worth reading rather than skipping, since a reviews app legitimately needs product and storefront access to import and display reviews, but you should know what you're granting before you click Install.

image.caption: The install permissions screen for Kudosi (Ali Reviews), listing access to customer data and to products, orders, discounts, and the Online Store.

steps.heading: Work through the app's setup wizard
steps.body: After installing, Kudosi walks you through its own three-step setup rather than dropping you straight into the dashboard. Step 3 of 3 is titled "Almost there! Install Review Box" — you select your store theme (Dawn, in most new stores) and choose which page to add the Review Box to, typically the home page or product pages. A visual preview on the right shows exactly where the box will sit in your theme's layout, circled on a mock product page, so you're not guessing at placement.

image.caption: The final step of Kudosi's setup wizard, adding the Review Box widget to a selected theme and page, with a preview showing its position.

steps.heading: Confirm the widget was added
steps.body: Once you click Add Review Box, the app automatically inserts the widget into the right spot in your theme, and the setup screen confirms with a green "Review Box added" message. Click Save in the theme editor, return to the app, and click Finish to complete setup. From here the review display mechanics are handled — the remaining work is actually getting reviews into the system.

steps.heading: Use Import Reviews to pull from AliExpress
steps.body: Inside the app, the left-hand menu splits review handling into Import Reviews, Collect Reviews, Manage Reviews, Show Reviews, Translation, Settings & Pricing, and Integration. Import Reviews is the section built for pulling existing AliExpress product reviews in, typically by pasting the AliExpress product URL you're sourcing from so the app can scrape and format matching reviews for your Shopify listing. Collect Reviews, by contrast, is for gathering new reviews from your own customers going forward — the two features solve different problems, so don't confuse them.

steps.heading: Check import status before publishing
steps.body: The reviews list uses status tabs — All Status, Scheduled, Sent, Opened, Partially reviewed, Reviewed, Cancelled, and Error — so you can track exactly where each batch of imported reviews stands. On a fresh install this list is empty, showing "Hmm, no data updated yet" until your first import job runs. Watching the Error tab specifically matters, since AliExpress listings occasionally fail to scrape cleanly and those failures need a retry rather than getting silently skipped.

image.caption: The Kudosi (Ali Reviews) dashboard, with Import Reviews and Collect Reviews in the app's left menu and status tabs for tracking each import batch.

steps.heading: Customize how reviews display on your storefront
steps.body: Once reviews are imported, use Show Reviews to control the layout, star styling, and which reviews surface first on a product page. Matching the widget's font and color scheme to your store's theme matters more than it seems — a review box that looks bolted on rather than native to your storefront undercuts the exact trust signal you installed the app to build in the first place.

faq.question: What does AI add to the review import process?
faq.answer: Apps like Kudosi use automated scraping and formatting to pull AliExpress reviews and match them to your Shopify listings in bulk, cutting out the manual copy-paste work of adding reviews one at a time.

faq.question: Is this method free to use?
faq.answer: Kudosi (Ali Reviews) is free to install, which covers getting reviews imported and displaying without an upfront cost, though higher review volumes or extra features may require a paid tier under Settings & Pricing.

faq.question: Who is this useful for?
faq.answer: It's aimed at dropshippers, e-commerce sellers, and anyone wanting to build credibility on a Shopify store without paying for expensive review-collection tools.

faq.question: What's the difference between Import Reviews and Collect Reviews in the app?
faq.answer: Import Reviews pulls existing reviews from AliExpress product listings into your store. Collect Reviews is a separate feature for gathering new reviews from your own customers after they purchase.
